decisive_spans.text: erythema and edematous necrotic plaques of the bilateral ears

response.rationale: Staphylococcal Scalded Skin Syndrome is directly supported by the presence of Staphylococcus hemolyticus bacteremia and the development of erythema and edematous necrotic plaques. Coumadin necrosis is also supported by the patient's history of hemophilia and skin necrosis, but the direct link to Staphylococcus hemolyticus bacteremia makes Staphylococcal Scaled Skin Syndrome a stronger candidate.
